description: Implementation of Android's ServiceManager class managing service registration, lookup, notifications, and lifecycle, including VINTF (Vendor Interface) integration.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a registered service with its binder, context, and client state.

classes.name: ServiceManager
classes.description: Manages service registration, lookup, notifications, and lifecycle, including VINTF integration.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves a binder for a service by name, optionally starting it if not found.

methods.name: checkService
methods.description: Checks for a service by name without starting it.

methods.name: tryGetService
methods.description: Internal method to get a service binder, starting it if necessary.

methods.name: addService
methods.description: Registers a new service with specified parameters.

methods.name: listServices
methods.description: Lists registered services filtered by dump priority.

methods.name: registerForNotifications
methods.description: Registers a callback for service registration notifications.

methods.name: unregisterForNotifications
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for service registration notifications.

methods.name: isDeclared
methods.description: Checks if a service is declared in VINTF.

methods.name: getDeclaredInstances
methods.description: Retrieves instances of a declared interface.

methods.name: updatableViaApex
methods.description: Checks if a service is updatable via APEX.

methods.name: getUpdatableNames
methods.description: Gets names of services updatable via a specific APEX.

methods.name: getConnectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves connection info for a service.

methods.name: tryUnregisterService
methods.description: Unregisters a service by name and binder.

methods.name: getServiceDebugInfo
methods.description: Provides debug info for all registered services.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all registered services and callbacks.
